item.subject: science
item.stem: Meena opens the lid of a pressure cooker in her kitchen in Jaipur, and the steam quickly spreads throughout the room. Which statement correctly explains why a gas, like this steam, does not have a fixed shape or a fixed volume?

options.A: Gas particles have a fixed shape but move slowly, so the gas takes the shape of its container.
options.B: Gas particles move freely in all directions and the forces of attraction between them are negligible, so the gas spreads to fill all the available space.
options.C: Gas particles are tightly packed together, so the gas expands when the lid is opened.
options.D: Gas is mostly empty space, so steam spreads by itself without the particles needing to move.
